# Tech Layoffs Tracker

> 69,705 verified tech-industry layoffs tracked since 2026-01-29, by company, country, and industry — every entry sourced and linked.

Canonical URL: https://innotechinsider.com/tech-layoffs-tracker/

Methodology: only layoffs confirmed with a specific, stated number from a real news source are counted — nothing
is estimated. Tracking starts 2026-01-29 forward; this is not a historical archive.
